subject: science
concept: Applying ecosystem knowledge to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student designs a simple, balanced mini-ecosystem scenario including producers, consumers, and decomposers
exercise.abstract: Student explains why their ecosystem design would be stable in a short written response

assessment.mastery_threshold: design includes all three organism roles and a plausible explanation of their balance
misconception_flags: designs an ecosystem missing a required role (e.g. no decomposers) without recognizing the gap

interest_binding: ecosystem theme generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
